_comment: The calculators on the solutions and guide pages. Every input is the visitor's own number; the values here are only where each slider starts, and each page says so. No industry averages. kind picks the arithmetic (build.py calc_results, the same in src/js/roi-calc.js): recover = n a week x 52/12 x r% x v; commission = n a month x v x r%; hours = n a week x 52/12 x t minutes x r% / 60; tco = (p + a) x 12 x y against our price. service is the menu item the result is set against; its price comes from data/pricing.json. won (recover only) names what comes back: jobs, new patients, admissions.

detailing.title: What missed calls cost a detailing studio
detailing.lede: Gloves on, car in the booth, phone in the office. Slide in your own numbers.

inputs.label: Calls you miss in a week
Average job
Of those callers, how many would have booked

detailing.note: Calls you miss × 4.33 weeks × the share who'd have booked × the average job. The starting numbers are an example, not a statistic: set them from your own call log.

clinic.title: What unanswered calls cost a practice
clinic.lede: The front desk is with a patient; the phone rings out. Slide in your own numbers.

inputs.label: Calls the front desk misses in a week
What a new patient's first visit is worth
Of those callers, how many would have booked

clinic.note: Calls missed × 4.33 weeks × the share who'd have booked × a first visit. It leaves out everything a patient is worth after the first visit, so the real figure is usually higher. The starting numbers are an example: use your own.

coaching.title: What a slow reply costs in admission season
coaching.lede: Classes are running when parents message. Slide in your own numbers.

inputs.label: Enquiries a week that get a late reply or none
Fees from one student over a year
Of those parents, how many would have joined

coaching.note: Enquiries missed × 4.33 weeks × the share who'd have joined × a year's fees. The starting numbers are an example, not a statistic: count a fortnight of your own enquiries.

gym.title: What a cold trial enquiry costs
gym.lede: Someone asks about a trial class at 11 pm and hears back the next afternoon. Slide in your own numbers.

inputs.label: Trial enquiries a week that go cold
What a member pays over their membership
Of those, how many would have joined

gym.note: Cold enquiries × 4.33 weeks × the share who'd have joined × what a member pays. The starting numbers are an example: your booking sheet has the real ones.

salon.title: What a booking app's cut adds up to
salon.lede: For the clients who already know you and book through an app that takes a share. Slide in your own numbers.

inputs.label: Bookings a month that go through the app
Average ticket
What the app takes from each booking

salon.note: Bookings × average ticket × the app's share. Apps charge in different ways: some only for new clients they send you, some a flat monthly plan. Use what your own plan charges; a new client an app finds for you can be worth its fee.

contractor.title: What a missed call costs on a job day
contractor.lede: On a roof, under a sink, driving between jobs. Slide in your own numbers.

inputs.label: Calls you miss on the job in a week
Average job
Of those callers, how many would have hired you

contractor.note: Calls missed × 4.33 weeks × the share who'd have hired you × the average job. The starting numbers are an example, not a statistic: your phone's call log has a fortnight of real ones.

missed-call.title: Your missed calls, in money
missed-call.lede: Three numbers you can read off your own phone and your own books.

inputs.label: Missed calls a week
Average customer value
Callers who'd book if someone got back to them

missed-call.note: Missed calls × 4.33 weeks × the share who'd book × what one customer is worth. The starting numbers are an example, not an industry figure: the share who'd book is the one to be honest with yourself about.

whatsapp.title: Time spent answering the same questions
whatsapp.lede: Count a normal week of chats. Slide in your own numbers.

inputs.label: WhatsApp messages you answer in a week
Minutes each one takes
How many are questions you've answered before

whatsapp.note: Messages × 4.33 weeks × minutes each × the share that are repeats, in hours. Routine questions are the part a bot can answer; the rest still comes to you. The starting numbers are an example: use your own week.

website.title: What a website costs over the years
website.lede: Put in what you pay, or would pay, each month. Slide in your own numbers.

inputs.label: Website builder or hosting plan, a month
Paid apps, plugins and themes, a month
Years

website.note: Builder or hosting plan plus paid add-ons, × 12 months × years, against a hand-built site paid for once. The starting numbers are an example, not any provider's price list: check your own plan.
